prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a coherent PIXEL ANIME GAME SPRITE SHEET of Khuê, a teenage male school reporter, wearing ivory short-sleeve shirt with dark cuffs, jade green necktie, navy straight trousers, brown shoes, brown reporter satchel on his ANATOMICAL RIGHT hip.
REFERENCE 1 is the approved character identity in the requested view. Match his head size, youthful face, navy hair, costume, body size and clean native pixel style.
REFERENCE 2 is the EXACT eight-frame storyboard for this view. Replace the mannequin with the character. It specifies limb positions, narrow passing poses and wide contact poses. Blue and dark are anatomical identity markers ONLY: do NOT paint one trouser leg a different permanent color.
REFERENCE 3 is the approved LEFT walking strip, STYLE and proportions only. Do not copy its facing direction.
Output precisely EIGHT full-body sprites on a TRANSPARENT sheet, FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Reading order frame0,1,2,3 top and4,5,6,7 bottom. Equal cells, centered at identical registration, head near y7, hip y32, foot ground y46 on a conceptual32x48 cell. Match storyboard's 4:3 sheet aspect. No labels, guide lines, borders, shadows outside sprite, blank bonus poses or ninth figure.
This is ONE animation sequence with the SAME coherent character model in every cell, not eight independently redesigned drawings. Keep head/face/torso and outfit shapes stable. Shoulder, elbow, hip, knee, ankle connections must read naturally. Consistent thigh and calf mass, visible hands and shoes; no tiny stick limbs, balloon limbs, twisted joints, disconnected legs or hands merging into the bag.
Motion: CONTACT wide -> CLOSING medium -> PASSING narrow with bent lifted knee and grounded support -> OPENING medium -> opposite CONTACT, then opposite closing/passing/opening. Arms counter-swing, move nearer body during passing and open at contact. Depth is shown by stable occlusion and restrained shading, NOT by random leg colors.
Pixel art: deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, flat limited palette, clean outlines; designed for32x48, not a detailed illustration reduced later. No soft glow, antialiasing, painterly gradients, melted shapes, realistic anatomy or costume changes. Transparent background and transparent cell margins. Do not enlarge head or shorten the body to fit.
VIEW AND ANATOMY:
Face RIGHT in every cell. Arrow points RIGHT in the guide. Anatomical RIGHT limbs are nearest camera and overlap LEFT limbs. Frame0 LEFT leg extends forward to screen RIGHT, RIGHT leg trails to screen LEFT; right arm extends forward opposing left leg. Satchel stays on right hip visible on near side. Frame2 left leg supports while right knee folds; frame4 reverses contact. Follow right storyboard, never face left.
